backend/main.mo: Main backend actor with mixins for storage and authorization; manages products, shopping carts, user profiles, branding/homepage configs, shop details, Stripe integration, description templates, and inventory with admin-only access controls.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features for deleting Stripe configuration: backend deletion method, React Query mutation hook, and UI component updates with cache invalidation.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, and hooks; describes marketplace, dashboard, checkout flow, Stripe setup with delete functionality, branding, and product management features.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI elements like background, foreground, primary, secondary, destructive, borders, and sidebar components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with UTF-8 charset, viewport meta tag, title "Original Creations Hub", root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for marketplace, dashboard, basket, checkout, payment success/failure, terms, and privacy; includes ThemeProvider, dynamic branding hook, and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/BrandingSettings: Admin component for configuring site branding including site name, logo, and favicon with file upload, preview, progress tracking, and clear functionality using ExternalBlob for image storage.
frontend/src/components/BulkProductUploa: Component for bulk uploading multiple products with image files, supporting description templates, auto-copy of fields across products, and progress tracking for each upload.
frontend/src/components/DescriptionTempl: Dialog component for creating and editing product description templates with name and content fields, using mutations for create/update operations.
Manager component that displays a list of description templates with edit and delete actions, including confirmation dialogs for deletion.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer displaying shop information, legal links (terms/privacy), contact details, and branding with caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/HomepageSettings: Admin settings component for customizing homepage hero section including motto text, promotional text, and hero image upload with preview.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper with sticky header navigation, authentication controls, shopping cart icon with item count, mobile menu, and admin dashboard link for authorized users.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a product card with image, name, shape, category, price, and an 'Add to Basket' button that uses the useAddToCart mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/ProductDetailVie: Modal dialog showing detailed product information with 'Add to Basket' and 'Buy Now' buttons; 'Buy Now' stores product ID in sessionStorage and navigates to checkout.
frontend/src/components/ProductManagemen: Admin table for managing products with inline editing for name, description, shape, category, price, and image upload; includes inventory count adjustment with plus/minus buttons.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Disabled component that returns null; previously handled profile setup modal after login.
frontend/src/components/ShopDetailsSetti: Form for managing shop information including name, contact details, address, opening hours, and company details with validation and update mutation.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetup.tsx: Configuration interface for setting up Stripe payments with secret key and allowed countries; displays configuration status and includes delete functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor with Internet Identity authentication; initializes access control with admin token from URL params and invalidates dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDynamicBranding.ts: Fetches branding configuration and dynamically updates document title and favicon based on the retrieved settings.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity storage, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including user profiles, products, cart management, orders, Stripe configuration, branding, and admin functions using TanStack Query.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for a warm terracotta and earthy color scheme supporting light and dark modes, plus Google Fonts imports for Crimson Pro and Inter.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient provider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page component that displays cart items or buy-now products, calculates totals, and creates Stripe checkout sessions for payment processing.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard with tabs for product management, bulk upload, Stripe setup, branding, shop details, homepage settings, and description templates, displaying inventory statistics and requiring admin access.
frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx: Main marketplace page with hero section, product filtering by search/shape/category, sorting options (most viewed, best selling, newest), and product detail modal view.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Displays a payment failure page with an error icon, message, and buttons to retry checkout or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Shows a payment success confirmation page that clears the cart and buyNowProductId from session storage on mount, with a button to continue shopping.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx: Renders a static privacy policy page covering data collection, usage, sharing, security, user rights, cookies, and contact information.
frontend/src/pages/ShoppingBasket.tsx: Displays the shopping cart with product items, quantity controls, remove functionality, and checkout button; shows empty state when cart is empty.
frontend/src/pages/Terms.tsx: Renders a static terms and conditions page covering products, pricing, shipping, returns, intellectual property, liability, and contact information.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup capabilities.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH, typography, container settings, animations, and plugins for the frontend application.
project_state.json: Project state file tracking an Artisan Hub marketplace application with bulk image upload, AI-generated descriptions, Stripe payments, and product management features. Documents known issues including image persistence failures in bulk upload and missing admin dashboard navigation link.
